name: ZARF's Spanish Translation mod
description: Spanish translation by ZARF (MOD-ZARF): menus, Story subtitles, memory-unit messages and Spanish font accents. Includes 158 recreated 4x HD Spanish textures covering 177 changed archive slots, original-game typography and a translated widescreen menu wall. Voices remain original. Enable one language at a time in Mods; disable and restart to return to English. Requires game 0.13.0 or later.
